mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, platform, social_id, user_name, role, status, gender, birth_date, height_cm, weight_kg, status_message, profile_image, allergies, diseases, is_public, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{platform}, #{socialId}, #{userName}, #{role}, #{status}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{statusMessage}, #{profileImage}, #{allergies}, #{diseases}, #{isPublic}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE social_id = #{socialId}

UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, status_message = #{statusMessage}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, allergies = #{allergies}, diseases = #{diseases}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
